description: Utilities for rendering Mustache templates. Mustache is a logic-less templating system that enables dynamic content generation from templates and data.

instructions.description:
Renders a template into a string.


A typical Mustache template:
```
Hello {{name}}
You have just won {{value}} dollars!
{{#in_ca}}
Well, {{taxed_value}} dollars, after taxes.
{{/in_ca}}
```

Given the following storage value:
```javascript
{
  "name": "Chris",
  "value": 10000,
  "taxed_value": 10000 - (10000 * 0.4),
  "in_ca": true
}
```
Will produce the following:
```
Hello Chris
You have just won 10000 dollars!
Well, 6000.0 dollars, after taxes.
```

See [manual](https://mustache.github.io/mustache.5.html) for details how to use all templating features.
